elaine: follow-up q from the roadmap segment: how are we measuring the impact of kernel-level scheduling on mixed-sequence workloads? curious about short-chat vs long-completion tails and what metrics drive go/no-go for a rollout.

raj: we run two primary suites: production sampling (random 1% of traffic with histograms by seq_len) and synthetic replay (1000 traces across short/med/long). decision factors: p99 by seq_len bucket, overall token throughput, and CPU/GPU utilization delta.

ben: does that mean different SLAs per bucket? customers care most about short-chat p99.

zoe: leadership guidance is to prioritize short-chat tail under 75ms p99 for the hosted tier. long completions can tolerate higher tail if throughput improves overall. we'll document per-tier targets in the SLA doc.

elaine: any config knobs we should tweak for fairness across seq lengths? currently short requests get batched into mixed batches with long requests and we see tail inflation.

raj: two knobs: prefer_same_seq batching and max_wait_ms. prefer_same_seq=true biases batcher to group similar-length requests; max_wait_ms controls latency/throughput tradeoff. starting config for canary: prefer_same_seq=true, max_wait_ms=6.

ben: can you paste the canary batcher config?

raj: here it is:
```
batcher:
  max_batch: 96
  prefer_same_seq: true
  max_wait_ms: 6
  partition_policy: seq_len_bucket
```

zoe: also enabling affinity-based scheduling so short sequences land on low-latency nodes; that helps tail without hurting long-run throughput.

release-bot: release-bot: kernel-schedule-v2 canary started at 1979991320 on cluster-canary-2

sre-bot: sre-alert: short-chat p99 spike +22ms vs baseline at 1979991382 in cluster-canary-2; attaching trace: https://traces.redwood.ai/trace/1979991382

raj: ack. initial look shows mixed-batches with a handful of very long requests. lowering max_batch to 64 for canary to reduce headroom.

elaine: what are rollback triggers? prefer explicit numbers we can automate.

zoe: rollback triggers: any bucket p99 > baseline + 20ms sustained for 15m, or overall error rate > 0.1% in 10m. automated rollback will flip to kernel-schedule-v1 and notify oncall.

ben: can we get a dashboard widget for per-bucket p99 so PMs can watch during rollout?

raj: creating dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/runtime/schedule-v2-preview (will share); adding PMs to watchers.

elaine: action items: raj post config + test vectors, ben add PM watchers to dashboard, zoe finalize SLA wording for short-chat. reconvene after 30m.

release-bot: release-bot: kernel-schedule-v2 canary completed 1979991460

sre-bot: sre-note: canary ended with net +3% throughput, short-chat p99 improved by 8ms on average after tuning. follow-up: schedule a 1hr soak with varied traffic.

elaine: great, thanks everyone 64f. please paste the final tuned config and the soak window here when scheduled.
